svg.title: Planning on paper in three pictures. 1: paint the left half of the design on the half-face template: a purple swirl over the brow, teal teardrops above it, pink dots on the cheekbone and half of a blue center dot. 2: copy each part onto the other half of a full face template, as if in a mirror, measuring from the same landmarks. Done: the whole design, the same on both sides.
